name: python-socketio-parameterized-namespace-routes
instr:
socketio cannot route class-based synchronous and asynchronous server and client handlers through parameterized namespaces. Add reusable absolute templates, deterministic concrete namespace dispatch, route parameters during invocation, and effective routing in administrator instrumentation.

`NamespaceRoute` parses literal and named segments, exposes `template` and `parameter_names`, and matches only complete namespaces with decoded independent values. @classmethod `NamespaceRoute.parse(cls, template)` raises `InvalidNamespaceRoute`, which is a ValueError carrying `template`, for malformed or duplicate declarations. `NamespaceRoute.match(self, namespace)` and @property `NamespaceRoute.specificity(self)` support matching and precedence. Prefer exact registrations, then parameterized routes by literal-segment count and depth, then catch-all. Indistinguishable templates raise `NamespaceRouteConflict`, which is a ValueError carrying `first_template` and `second_template`.

Registrations return `NamespaceRegistration` receipts whose `route`, `active`, `NamespaceRegistration.unregister(self)`, and removal behavior always reflect current ownership. Replacement is atomic for future resolution, while existing bindings retain their handler. Every dispatch selects one handler and one concrete namespace. Synchronous, nested, asynchronous, concurrent, failed, and cancelled invocations isolate bindings. Outside dispatch, @property `route_params(self)` and @property `route_namespace(self)`
